notes: Each configured action must be an object: {"tool": "EXACT_TOOL_NAME", "args": {"EXACT_ARGUMENT_NAME": "$busIndex"}, "valuePath": "content.0.text"}. Use exact names/argument keys from inspect-tools output. For reads, valuePath must identify the numeric dB value or boolean mute state in the MCP result. For meterRead, valuePath must identify a numeric value or list of numeric dBFS values. The example path is only a syntax illustration; it may not match your tool response.
